Moushumi’s upcoming movie Orjon 71
2019-07-13T00:00:00+06:00 | Arts & Entertainment Desk
https://www.thedailystar.net/arts-entertainment/news/moushumis-upcoming-movie-orjon-71-1770478

Popular actor Moushumi has signed on for a new film titled Orjon 71, directed by Mirza Sakhawat Hossain. The muhurat for the movie will be held at the Bangladesh Film Development Corporation (BFDC) premises on July 16.

Orjon 71 is based on the limitless contributions of the Bangladeshi police force during the Liberation War of 1971. Moushumi will be seen playing the role of Firoza, an integral character in the movie. Shatabdi Wadud will be playing the role of a courageous police officer, opposite Moushumi. The movie will be filmed at BFDC, Rajarbagh Police Line and a few locations in North Bengal.

Apart from Orjon 71, Moushumi is also working on the film Modhu Da. Her latest release was Nolok, which premiered last Eid ul Fitr.
